answer.reason: The verses tell of Amon's evil worship and his death by conspiracy, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: sacrificed to the carved images his father Manasseh had made, and served them
clauses.quote: Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them

clauses.english: was killed by his servants, who conspired against him in his own house
clauses.quote: the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house

doubts: Verses naming Amon only as father of Josiah (JER 1:2, JER 25:3, ZEP 1:1, MAT 1:10, 1CH 3:14) add nothing beyond the summary and were not used.
